outreach_note_draft:
Subject: A partner program for creators who cover [topic]

Hi [Name],

I saw your video [title of the video that mentions us]. Visitors who reach us from the video platform as a whole engaged at 60% in the last 90 days, against 20% for our site overall, so that audience fits what we do. We can't see which channel sent them; your own link would show what your viewers do. We're starting a small partner program and would like you in it: 25% of each referred customer's first-year revenue, a 30-day cookie window, and monthly payouts. You'd get your own link, an account to try the product and a one-page summary of who the product is for.

Would you like the details?

[Your name]
outreach_note_basis: youtube.com is a platform, not one creator: GA4 doesn't show which channel sent the visits, so the note quotes the platform figure as the platform's and gives the creator no numbers of their own
